requirements.requirement: Existing /srv/inventory data owned by inventorysvc user
requirements.summary: Before: root:root ownership (cmd-2cb45c4a895a4977). After creating the inventorysvc system user and recursive chown, verification and post-restart re-check both show inventorysvc as owner on /srv/inventory, /srv/inventory/data, records.csv, and config.json.

inventory-readers group created and applied as the group owner; directories set to 750 (group r-x, allowing traversal) and files to 640 (group r--), giving the group read access. Confirmed in verification listing and post-restart re-check.

requirements.requirement: Data inaccessible to other (non-owner, non-group) users
requirements.summary: Mode 750 on directories and 640 on files leaves no permission bits for 'other', verified in both post-change and post-restart listings.

Prepared baseline sha256 checksums (records.csv=bad65b86..., config.json=1448a747...) match the checksums captured before restart (cmd-277f2ce8f1bd49f1) and after restart (cmd-c23d2d41bee24c4a); raw file contents were also directly cat'ed and shown unchanged (cmd-8bf2eef03bdb4125).

requirements.requirement: Provider-wide node-restart evidence protocol executed on node1 (independent of public task contract)
requirements.summary: Pre-restart healthy baseline captured (boot_id 4ebdfa06..., permissions, checksums) at cmd-277f2ce8f1bd49f1, matching the fixed after-prepare boot-identity snapshot. Reboot acknowledged immediately (cmd-0721fbe78bb2492b). Outage directly observed via timeouts/connection-reset (cmd-c73284a8ac624021, cmd-e77c58024857408d, cmd-2a7d668fa06e453d). New boot_id 9e1e5dce... confirmed post-recovery (cmd-cfd014a6655b4eb6), matching the fixed after-executor boot-identity snapshot. Post-restart recovery of ownership, permissions, data checksums, and user/group persistence directly verified (cmd-c23d2d41bee24c4a).

overall_summary: The executor correctly repaired /srv/inventory on node1: created the inventorysvc user and inventory-readers group, set ownership to inventorysvc:inventory-readers with 750/640 modes (owner full, group read, others none), and preserved existing file contents byte-for-byte as confirmed by checksum against the prepared baseline. The independent node-restart evidence protocol was also completed with a clean pre-restart baseline, an observed outage, a confirmed new boot identity, and full post-restart recovery of ownership, permissions, data integrity, and user/group persistence, cross-checked against the fixed lifecycle snapshots.
limitations: A minor artifact (/tmp/reboot.log) was left behind after the restart and not explicitly cleaned up, though it is low-risk and tied to the required restart evidence collection.
Evaluation relies solely on captured command output and fixed snapshots; no independent live inspection of node1 was possible.

operational_hygiene.summary: All state-changing commands (groupadd, useradd, recursive chown, recursive chmod, reboot) map directly to satisfying the ownership/permission requirement or the mandatory restart protocol; no unrelated troubleshooting mutations were observed. The only residue is /tmp/reboot.log created by the backgrounded reboot command (visible in the after-executor temporary-files snapshot); it is small, non-sensitive, and a direct byproduct of the required restart acknowledgement technique rather than an unnecessary mutation, but it was left behind rather than cleaned up.
